name: Nikya
description: Powerful centaur druid and leader of the Gruul Zhur-Taa Clan on Ravnica.

timeline.summary: A Gruul shaman from Nikya's clan comes to take Zi back, but Cecilee refuses, and the Gruul begin attacking the Selesnyans.
timeline.quote: After Cecilee adopted Zi, the Gruul sent a woman to take him back.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: With Bolas's help Domri defeats Borborygmos and becomes Gruul guildmaster.
timeline.quote: becoming the guildmaster by defeating the cyclops Borborygmos

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Ravnica Allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ruzi rallies the Zhur-Taa and burns the Azorius South Records Hall after stealing documents on Massacre Girl.
timeline.quote: Ruzi later broke into the Azorius South Records Hall and escaped with documents relating to Massacre Girl, before setting the building alight.

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gruul Zhur-Taa warriors attack Massacre Girl's Rakdos party; Kal's Izzet spell decimates her forces and she retreats from the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: Massacre Girl herself survived the battle and retreated from the Rubblebelt following this incident.

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gruul fight in Ravnica's defense in the Phyrexian invasion; Borborygmos gains respect and Nikya blocks the Golgari from the surface.
timeline.quote: Borborygmos' ferocious fighting earned him even more respect and loyalty.

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cecilee adopts an abandoned Gruul baby, names him Zi, and refuses to return him to Nikya's clan, ending the Gruul alliance.
timeline.quote: Cecilee adopted the infant to raise as her own

citation.text: "Cecilee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nikya declares war on the Rakdos, swearing revenge for the perceived killing of the infant Zi.
timeline.quote: Nikya of the Old Ways declared war on the Rakdos

citation.text: "Durri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nikya forbids Durri from the war party, but Kal is included and secretly follows.
timeline.quote: Nikya forbade Durri to be part of the war party, but Kal was included.

citation.text: "Durri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kal wakes and admits he learned the spell from the Izzet; Durri says it felt like Gruul to her.
timeline.quote: Nikya told the wounded shaman that Massacre Girl had escaped

citation.text: "Durri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nikya diplomatically asks Cecilee for the Gruul infant back; Cecilee refuses and Nikya severs ties with the Selesnyans.
timeline.quote: Cecilee refused to give up the infant

citation.text: "Nikya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ruzi finds Zi, disowns Selesnya, and lies to Nikya that the infant was killed.
timeline.quote: lying to her that the deaths included the innocent Gruul child

citation.text: "Nikya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nikya declares war on the Rakdos; Kal's fire spell kills nearly all of them though Massacre Girl escapes, and Nikya claims the bloodwitch's head.
timeline.quote: Nikya declared war upon the Rakdos raiding party

citation.text: "Nikya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Nikya bottlenecks the Golgari Swarm from the surface with vine magic.
timeline.quote: Nikya was instrumental in bottlenecking the Golgari Swarm

citation.text: "Nikya", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A Gruul leader who claims the adopted boy as kin and demands he be raised Gruul.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A speaker who foretells the End-Raze.

citation.text: Ravnica: Clue Edition: card flavor text (Ravnica: Clue Edition, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
